title: One line of the tollman's train state (train.jsonl)
description: A change of a wagon train (hal2 plan 0294 step 6; scripts/train_state.py): `slot` is the carrier's field, on an `unhitched` line the field whose ready mark went, on a `barn` line the field already in the barn (`yard`: the yard's car, step 8).

cars.description: A formed line: the cars in the order they are merged, each an object with field, branch, head and plan; a landed line: their fields.

base.description: The carrier's head before the cars were merged; an order line: the carrier's head the fix branches from.

status.description: A red line: the landing's result (`gate_failed`, `conflict`, `error`, ...).

run.description: The land run's address; a run line: the run of the landing that runs now, found by watch.py (plan 0360 step 5); a pause line: the run watched when the pause came (the one it cancels, step 18).

commit.description: A landed line: the commit on the default branch; a yard line: the yard's commit in the carrier's field; a regenerated line: the train's last commit, which wrote the generated files again; a started line after a retry: the empty commit that gives the landing a new candidate, so a fresh run (plan 0313 step 13).

files.description: A yard line: the yard's files that ride as the train's first car, each an object with path and hash (the hash of what was carried; none for a deletion). An unhitched line of the slot `yard`: the files that stay out until they change. A regenerated line: the paths of the generated files written again (plan 0313 step 8).

yard.description: A landed line of a train the yard rode: what was done in the yard afterwards: dropped (paths), kept (path and why), pulled, why.

pushed.description: A cleared or formed line: what became of the carrier's remote branch, which a dead train's landing had pushed (put back on the base with a leased push, or why not; plan 0313 steps 1 and 14); none when there was nothing to push.

seconds.description: A pretest line: how long the pretest took.

jobs.description: A pretest line: one object per configured job, with job, key, state (cached, run, skipped, not needed), seconds, result and why.

field.description: An order or fixed line: the car's field the fix order is for, `main` (the barn's red, the tollman's own hand; plan 0360 step 6) or a smuggling field (step 18). A pause line: the smuggle's slot that paused the landing; a resumed line: the smuggles since the last resume (plan 0360 step 18).

seq.description: A pause line: the smuggle's ticket number (the queue's `paused_by.seq`): one line per pause.

since.description: A pause line: since when the smuggle paused the landing (the queue's `paused_by.since`).

branch.description: An order line: the side branch the fix is made on, `<NN>-train-fix` or `tollman-train-fix`.

id.description: An order or fixed line: the fix order's id, `<field>-fix-<n>`.

sha.description: A fixed line: the fix's commit the foreman answered with.

head.description: A barn line: the head of the field that was in the barn already when the tollman woke from smuggle mode (plan 0360 step 25, D75).

how.description: A barn line: a waiting hitch (its mark cleared), a car of a formed train (it left the train, D76) or of a running train (only recorded).

by.description: An unhitched line of a car of the standing train: taken out by the user's own command (`--by-user`, plan 0360 D3); the session never takes a car out of a formed train.
